###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to fix the screenshots and confirm the left-sidebar match. Don't assign a reviewer yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the updates, @Ayush-0217! Please retake the dark-theme before/after screenshots of the exact same region, following the [precise screenshots guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots). Also say how the focus color and border radius now match the left sidebar link, and confirm the "View all users" styles are not in this PR.
```
